cli.run.noSpec: no .helm/spec.json — starting a plain session (engagement runs are spec-driven)

attack.pending: attack-coverage: no ATT&CK-mapped findings yet (mapping lands with W3 engagement; navigator reference: references/attack-navigator.json)

settings.hint.search: Type to search · Enter/Space to change · Esc to cancel
settings.hint.plain: Enter/Space to change · Esc to cancel
status.language: Language: {{locale}} — applies to newly rendered text
settings.language.label: Language / 语言
settings.language.desc: UI language. Auto: system locale (POSIX LANG/LC_ALL, then OS language), then timezone (Asia/Shanghai-class → 中文). Machine outputs stay English.
settings.efficiency-action-fusion.label: Efficiency: action fusion
settings.efficiency-action-fusion.desc: SoL-Pi action-fusion mechanism (helm built-in, default on; opt-out is per mechanism)
settings.efficiency-reducer.label: Efficiency: evidence-preserving reducer
settings.efficiency-reducer.desc: SoL-Pi context reducer that keeps evidence intact (default on)
settings.defense-watcher.label: Budget watcher (G4)
settings.defense-watcher.desc: Live token-budget structural review every N turns (default off per §0; hard stop stays budget-gated)
settings.autocompact.label: Auto-compact
settings.autocompact.desc: Automatically compact context when it gets too large
settings.steering-mode.label: Steering mode
settings.steering-mode.desc: Enter while streaming queues steering messages. 'one-at-a-time': deliver one, wait for response. 'all': deliver all at once.
settings.follow-up-mode.label: Follow-up mode
settings.follow-up-mode.desc: {{key}} queues follow-up messages until agent stops. 'one-at-a-time': deliver one, wait for response. 'all': deliver all at once.
settings.transport.label: Transport
settings.transport.desc: Preferred transport for providers that support multiple transports
settings.http-idle-timeout.label: HTTP idle timeout
settings.http-idle-timeout.desc: Maximum idle gap while waiting for HTTP headers or body chunks. Disable for local models that pause longer than five minutes.
settings.cache-warming-mode.label: Cache warming
settings.cache-warming-mode.desc: off; streaming while the agent runs; idle also between runs while continuation stays profitable
settings.hide-thinking.label: Hide thinking
settings.hide-thinking.desc: Hide thinking blocks in assistant responses
settings.mermaid-rendering.label: Mermaid diagrams
settings.mermaid-rendering.desc: Render Mermaid code blocks as Unicode diagrams
settings.cache-miss-notices.label: Cache miss notices
settings.cache-miss-notices.desc: Show transcript notices for cache costs and provider recovery diagnostics
settings.collapse-changelog.label: Collapse changelog
settings.quiet-startup.label: Quiet startup
settings.install-telemetry.label: Install telemetry
settings.install-telemetry.desc: Send an anonymous version/update ping after changelog-detected updates
settings.default-project-trust.label: Default project trust
settings.default-project-trust.desc: Fallback behavior when no extension or saved trust decision decides project trust
settings.double-escape-action.label: Double-escape action
settings.double-escape-action.desc: Action when pressing Escape twice with empty editor
settings.tree-filter-mode.label: Tree filter mode
settings.warnings.label: Warnings
settings.model-thinking.label: Default thinking level per model
settings.model-thinking.desc: Override the default thinking level for specific models. {{cycleKey}} cycles in-session.
settings.tui-mode.label: TUI mode
settings.tui-mode.desc: Interface layout; fullscreen mode is experimental
settings.fullscreen-exit-output.label: Fullscreen exit output
settings.fullscreen-exit-output.desc: Print the transcript or only a session resume hint when exiting fullscreen mode
settings.fullscreen-scrollbar.label: Fullscreen scrollbar
settings.fullscreen-scrollbar.desc: Scrollbar behavior in fullscreen mode; has no effect in regular mode
settings.fullscreen-copy-on-select.label: Fullscreen copy on select
settings.fullscreen-copy-on-select.desc: Automatically copy selected text in fullscreen mode; disable to copy selections with Ctrl+X
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.show-images.label: Show images
settings.image-width-cells.label: Image width
settings.image-width-cells.desc: Preferred inline image width in terminal cells
settings.auto-resize-images.label: Auto-resize images
settings.auto-resize-images.desc: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility
settings.block-images.label: Block images
settings.block-images.desc: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers
settings.skill-commands.label: Skill commands
settings.show-hardware-cursor.label: Show hardware cursor
settings.show-hardware-cursor.desc: Show the terminal cursor while still positioning it for IME support
settings.editor-padding.label: Editor padding
settings.output-padding.label: Output padding
settings.output-padding.desc: Horizontal padding for user messages, assistant messages, and thinking
settings.autocomplete-max-visible.label: Autocomplete max items
settings.autocomplete-max-visible.desc: Max visible items in autocomplete dropdown (3-20)
settings.clear-on-shrink.label: Clear on shrink
settings.clear-on-shrink.desc: Clear empty rows when content shrinks (may cause flicker)
settings.terminal-progress.label: Terminal progress
settings.terminal-progress.desc: Show OSC 9;4 progress indicators in the terminal tab bar
slash.export.desc: Export session (HTML default, or specify path: .html/.jsonl)
slash.import.desc: Import and resume a session from a JSONL file
slash.share.desc: Share session as a secret GitHub gist
slash.bug.desc: Report a bug to the helm developers
slash.copy.desc: Copy last agent message to clipboard
slash.fork.desc: Create a new fork from a previous user message
slash.clone.desc: Duplicate the current session at the current position
slash.trust.desc: Save project trust decision for future sessions
slash.reload.desc: Reload keybindings, extensions, skills, prompts, themes, and context files
